newsitem.title: USA: ADM files $500 mln shelf of debt, warrants.
newsitem.headline: ADM files $500 mln shelf of debt, warrants.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $500 million in debt securities and warrants.
Together with previously registered securities, the Decatur, Ill., food conglomerate's shelf offering totals $650 million, according to the SEC filing made late Thursday.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include funding working capital needs, capital expenditures and possible acquisitions.
No underwriters were named in the filing.
